synthetic_bank_finding.what: The 10 subject-axis banks of 2026-10-25 use formula-generated metric values and verify only their own minted bytes.
synthetic_bank_finding.evidence: build_csoai_subject_and_datasets_banks.py: canonical_metric_value = round(0.85 + ((idx % 12) * 0.01), 4); expected_payload_sha256 = sha256(canonical(payload)) over the builder payload itself.
synthetic_bank_finding.consequence: Those banks are CANDIDATE_FINDING and must not be promoted as measurements. The banks written by this run carry live-fetched bytes instead.

board_promotion_blockers: Board admission for a subject axis needs a signed card under the council signing path; signing is the owner gate (g2_gate.py: "Enabling any signing from this list is Nick's call").
Materiality of a claim delta is a human adjudication; this run never automates that verdict.
The crosswalk router coverage that the bank derivation depends on is still gated on council PR #3504 (published crosswalk maps 7 of 417 provisions).
